sql:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN in_patient_count > out_patient_count THEN 'More in-patients'
        ELSE 'More out-patients'
    END AS result,
    ((in_patient_count - out_patient_count) / NULLIF(out_patient_count, 0)) * 100 AS percentage_deviation
FROM (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID ELSE NULL END) AS in_patient_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID ELSE NULL END) AS out_patient_count
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'M'
)
